prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1382; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Reviewed the initial loss report for the left-turn collision. Insured states they were turning left at an intersection when the other vehicle proceeded through on a green signal. Police report requested and pending. Photos of both vehicles uploaded to file.

Entry 2: Claimant's attorney has notified this office of representation and requested that all further contact go through counsel. Acknowledgment letter sent. Claimant reports neck pain and stiffness consistent with whiplash and has begun treatment with a chiropractor.

Entry 3: Obtained the recorded statement from the insured. Insured confirms signal timing was reviewed and maintains the claimant's vehicle entered the intersection at speed. Intersection camera footage requested from the municipality, response expected in several business days.

Entry 4: Received medical records from claimant's treating provider through counsel. Diagnosis listed as cervical strain with whiplash-type symptoms. Records reviewed and forwarded to the medical review unit for assessment of treatment reasonableness. Counsel has requested a demand package, which is under review.

Entry 5: Liability analysis updated. Based on the police report narrative and partial camera footage, liability appears to be shared, with the insured likely bearing the greater share due to the left-turn yield requirement. Reserve reviewed and adjusted for the bodily injury component. Supervisor review scheduled to confirm settlement authority before any counter-offer is made to counsel.
